hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Production casing section (5-1/2 in.)
function: The section of production casing the plug sets in, drawn translucent so the tools inside can be seen.

tabs.overview: Casing ID sets the plug OD and the clearance that lets the string be pumped down; 5-1/2 in. 20 lb/ft has a 4.778 in. ID. Slips bite into this wall; the element seals against it.
tabs.engineering: API 5CT casing; grade and weight per the well design.
tabs.safety: Casing wear from pump-down and milling is a long-term concern.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
